Resolves #6564
Related: #15000

Restores `grid.Body#onStoreFilter` and `grid.Body#onStoreLoad` from `#bodyHandlers` and removes `'neo-animate-rows'` in `grid.plugin.AnimateRows#destroy()`, and updates `grid.Body#afterSetAnimatedRowSorting` so disabling `animatedRowSorting` at runtime destroys and removes the `grid-animate-rows` plugin while guarding in-flight dynamic imports against destroyed or disabled bodies.

Evidence: L2 (Playwright unit suites `test/playwright/unit/grid/AnimateRowsContentSized.spec.mjs` and `test/playwright/unit/grid/AnimateRowsSteps.spec.mjs` executed outside CI at exact head `e34a843bf1eb34b7c91eb78fd6e1345bf5ee8058` with `NEO_TEST_SKIP_CI` unset — `16 passed, 0 skipped`; hosted unit job `127263809535` sets `NEO_TEST_SKIP_CI` and skips both CSS-transition timing suites) → L2 required (unit verification of store listener restoration and runtime `animatedRowSorting` toggling).

## AC Evidence
| Bullet | Verification |
|---|---|
| 1 | `test/playwright/unit/grid/AnimateRowsContentSized.spec.mjs` — `a destroyed plugin restores the body store listeners and removes neo-animate-rows` (verified outside CI with `NEO_TEST_SKIP_CI` unset at `e34a843bf1`, `16/16 passed`; skipped in hosted CI job `127263809535`) |
| 2 | `test/playwright/unit/grid/AnimateRowsContentSized.spec.mjs` — `animatedRowSorting toggled off and back on at runtime destroys and recreates the plugin` (verified outside CI with `NEO_TEST_SKIP_CI` unset at `e34a843bf1`, `16/16 passed`; skipped in hosted CI job `127263809535`) |

## Deltas from ticket
Built on `#bodyHandlers` introduced in PR #19774 (#6858) so `AnimateRows#destroy()` restores the original `onStoreFilter` and `onStoreLoad` references and rebinds `owner.store`, while `grid.Body#afterSetAnimatedRowSorting` only destroys the plugin when `oldValue !== undefined` so a plugin declared directly in `plugins` is not torn down by the default `animatedRowSorting: false` config.

## Test Evidence
- `npm run test-unit -- test/playwright/unit/grid/AnimateRowsContentSized.spec.mjs test/playwright/unit/grid/AnimateRowsSteps.spec.mjs` — executed outside CI at exact head `e34a843bf1eb34b7c91eb78fd6e1345bf5ee8058` with `NEO_TEST_SKIP_CI` unset (`16 passed, 0 skipped`, independently verified by author and reviewer `@neo-gpt-emmy` in review `5786452620`); hosted unit job [`127263809535`](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/actions/runs/42031860679/job/127263809535) sets `NEO_TEST_SKIP_CI` and skips both CSS-transition timing suites.

- [ ] None required; covered by outside-CI unit execution (`NEO_TEST_SKIP_CI` unset, `16/16 passed` at `e34a843bf1eb34b7c91eb78fd6e1345bf5ee8058`).
